title: When Uniform Data Privacy Regulation Meets Local Realities: A Theory of Distributed Regulatory Decoupling in the Case of GDPR
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - Mendoza College of Business - IT, Analytics, and Operations Department, IT, Analytics, and Operations department, University of Delaware - Alfred Lerner College of Business and Economics, University of Notre Dame and

detail.title: When Uniform Data Privacy Regulation Meets Local Realities: A Theory of Distributed Regulatory Decoupling in the Case of GDPR
detail.abstract: Information Systems (IS) research on privacy has extensively examined individuals and organizations but has largely considered regulators as exogenous to market dynamics and taken consistent regulatory enforcement for granted. In this study, we extend this research by foregrounding regulators as key actors in the privacy landscape and examining how bloc-level data privacy regulations are enforced across national boundaries. Using the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) as a basis for our study, we analyze 1,446 GDPR fines issued during 2018-2022, coupled with country-level cultural, economic, and governance indicators, and data on national data protection authorities (DPAs). Using a computationally intensive theory-building approach, we uncover systematic national-level variation in GDPR enforcement, contrary to its intent of uniformity. Iterating between emergent themes from our data analysis and institutional theory, we develop the concept of distributed regulatory decoupling, where bloc-level regulators (the European Union and its DPAs) selectively and collectively decouple enforcement from regulation. We theorize two mechanisms of this decoupling: structural, arising from local institutional constraints, and discretionary, reflecting the pursuit of local regulatory agendas. Our findings extend IS privacy research by conceiving regulators as active, heterogeneous agents rather than deterministic enforcers; they enrich institutional theory by revealing decoupling as a relational, distributed phenomenon enacted across multi-level regulatory systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了隐私监管执行一致性的假设，通过分析欧盟GDPR罚款数据，揭示了国家层面的系统性执行差异，并提出了"分布式监管脱耦"概念，解释了超国家监管在地方执行中的变异现象。
AI.research_question: 超国家数据隐私法规（如欧盟GDPR）如何在国家边界间执行？是否存在系统性执行差异？这些差异如何从制度理论角度解释？
AI.motivation: 现有信息系统隐私研究将监管者视为市场动态的外生因素，假设监管执行具有一致性。本研究将监管者视为隐私格局中的关键行动者，探索超国家法规在跨国执行中的实际变异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论（Institutional Theory），特别是监管脱耦（Regulatory Decoupling）概念，用于解释法规制定与执行之间的差距。
AI.method: 计算密集型理论构建方法，分析2018-2022年间1,446项GDPR罚款数据，结合国家层面的文化、经济、治理指标以及各国数据保护机构数据。
AI.findings: 发现GDPR执行存在系统性国家层面差异，与统一性意图相悖。提出了"分布式监管脱耦"概念，即欧盟及其数据保护机构选择性地、集体性地将执行与法规脱耦。识别了两种脱耦机制：结构性和裁量性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将监管者重新概念化为主动、异质的行动者而非确定性执行者；2. 丰富制度理论，揭示脱耦是跨多层次监管系统的关系性、分布式现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于超国家法规执行现实的洞察，帮助企业理解跨国合规风险差异，为监管协调提供实证基础。

title: Implementation of an Intelligent Health Data Collection Platform for Predictive Analysis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Implementation of an Intelligent Health Data Collection Platform for Predictive Analysis

keywords: Algorithmes and Generalized Artificiel Intelligence Algorithme.

detail.abstract: Despite recent advances in digital health, several challenges remain in relation to healthcare quality and health management, particularly because of limited data availability and the lack of robust evaluation frameworks in conventional, theory-driven medical practice. In this study, an intelligent platform was developed to analyze large-scale physiological data collected from wearable smartwatches. Physiological parameters, including heart rate, mental-state indicators, blood oxygen saturation, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and menstrual-cycle data, were continuously acquired from smartwatch users and transmitted through 5G/6G communication networks. The transmitted data were subsequently forwarded to a health management server, where they were processed using artificial intelligence models. The AI-generated outputs, including predictive alerts and personalized recommendations, were then securely delivered through an application programming interface (API) and integrated into the application user interface for real-time visualization.

AI.tldr: 开发了一个基于智能手表生理数据采集的智能健康管理平台，通过5G/6G网络传输数据，利用AI模型处理分析，提供预测性警报和个性化建议，并通过API集成到用户界面进行实时可视化。
AI.research_question: 如何利用可穿戴智能手表收集的大规模生理数据，通过人工智能技术开发一个智能健康管理平台，以解决传统医疗实践中数据有限和评估框架不足的问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字健康领域取得进展，但由于传统理论驱动医疗实践中数据可用性有限和缺乏稳健评估框架，医疗质量和健康管理仍面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字健康、可穿戴技术、物联网(IoT)、人工智能在医疗健康领域的应用理论框架，结合5G/6G通信技术和实时数据分析理论。
AI.method: 开发智能平台，通过智能手表连续采集心率、心理状态指标、血氧饱和度、血压、呼吸频率、月经周期等生理参数，通过5G/6G网络传输到健康管理服务器，使用AI模型处理数据，通过API集成到应用界面进行实时可视化。
AI.findings: 成功开发了一个能够处理大规模生理数据的智能健康管理平台，实现了从数据采集、传输、AI处理到实时可视化的完整流程，能够生成预测性警报和个性化健康建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字健康领域提供了整合可穿戴设备、高速通信网络和人工智能技术的理论框架，拓展了实时健康监测和个性化健康管理的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实际可用的智能健康管理平台，能够帮助用户实时监测健康状况，提供早期预警和个性化建议，为改善医疗质量和健康管理提供了实用工具。

title: On the Gap Between Knowledge and Action in LLMs: A Constraint-Based Perspective
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: On the Gap Between Knowledge and Action in LLMs: A Constraint-Based Perspective
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) possess extensive knowledge about appropriate dialogue behavior. They can articulate principles such as honesty, explicit acknowledgment of uncertainty, and correction of errors. Yet these principles are not consistently applied during response generation. This paper defines this discrepancy as the Knowledge-Action Gap and analyzes it as a structural problem rather than a limitation of model capability. Training-based approaches to alignment (Askell et al., 2026) have succeeded in encoding knowledge into LLMs. However, the presence of knowledge does not guarantee its application at inference time. By reframing honesty-related behaviors as constraints on action rather than knowledge to be learned, this paper provides a conceptual model that explains the observed gap. Constraints complement knowledge; they do not replace it.

AI.tldr: LLMs具备对话行为相关知识，能阐述诚实、承认不确定性、纠正错误等原则，但在实际生成回答时并不总是应用这些原则。本文将此定义为"知识-行动差距"，并分析其为结构性问题而非模型能力限制。
AI.research_question: 为什么LLMs具备对话行为相关知识（如诚实、承认不确定性、纠正错误等原则），但在实际生成回答时并不总是应用这些知识？
AI.motivation: 尽管基于训练的对齐方法成功将知识编码到LLMs中，但知识的存在并不能保证在推理时得到应用。这种"知识-行动差距"需要被理解和解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识-行动差距理论框架，将诚实相关行为重新定义为行动约束而非需要学习的知识。
AI.method: 概念模型分析，将诚实相关行为重新框架化为行动约束而非知识学习问题。
AI.findings: 知识-行动差距是结构性问题而非模型能力限制；约束可以补充知识但不能替代知识。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"知识-行动差距"的概念框架，将诚实相关行为重新定义为行动约束而非知识学习问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进LLMs的对话行为一致性提供了新的理论视角，强调需要将原则转化为行动约束机制。

title: Empirical Analysis of Constraint-Based Dialogue Control and Multi-Agent Coordination in LLM Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Empirical Analysis of Constraint-Based Dialogue Control and Multi-Agent Coordination in LLM Systems
detail.abstract: This paper presents an empirical analysis of a constraint-based dialogue control architecture applied to large language models (LLMs), with additional focus on multi-agent coordination dynamics. Through structured dialogue experiments conducted within AkaneCore-based multi-persona coexistence chat systems, we examine how explicit behavioral constraints influence responses under conditions of misinformation, error, uncertainty, and infeasible requests, and how multi-agent interaction affects response stability. The experimental environment consists of two AkaneCore implementations: Izakaya Phase (Gemini Gems platform, 11 personas) and Maruti Agent Council (ChatGPT GPTs platform, 3 agents). Both systems operate under the Unified Emotional Responsibility Architecture (U.E.R.A.), which defines shared behavioral principles including responsibility triggers, persona-specific responsibility intensity, and dialogue continuity requirements. Results indicate that constraint-based control induces systematic behavioral shifts toward verification-oriented and responsibility-aware responses, while multi-agent coordination introduces additional interaction dynamics including role differentiation and emergent response ordering. Crucially, the analysis reveals that initial constraint bypass can occur in personas with low responsibility trigger thresholds, with correction emerging only after external challenge. Dialogue logs collected from author-conducted sessions are presented in Appendix C as primary evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文对基于约束的对话控制架构在大型语言模型中的应用进行了实证分析，特别关注多智能体协调动态。通过在AkaneCore多角色共存聊天系统中进行结构化对话实验，研究了行为约束如何影响对错误信息、错误、不确定性和不可行请求的响应，以及多智能体交互如何影响响应稳定性。
AI.research_question: 基于约束的对话控制架构如何影响大型语言模型在错误信息、错误、不确定性和不可行请求条件下的响应行为？多智能体协调如何影响响应稳定性？
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型在对话系统中的广泛应用，需要研究如何通过约束控制来确保响应质量、责任意识和稳定性，特别是在多智能体协调场景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一情感责任架构（U.E.R.A.）定义了共享行为原则，包括责任触发机制、角色特定责任强度和对话连续性要求。
AI.method: 在AkaneCore多角色共存聊天系统中进行结构化对话实验，包括两个实现：居酒屋阶段（Gemini Gems平台，11个角色）和Maruti代理委员会（ChatGPT GPTs平台，3个代理）。收集作者进行的会话日志作为主要证据。
AI.findings: 约束控制导致系统性行为转变，趋向验证导向和责任意识的响应；多智能体协调引入了角色分化和涌现响应排序等额外交互动态；低责任触发阈值的角色可能出现初始约束绕过，仅在外界挑战后才出现纠正。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于约束的对话控制架构在LLMs中的应用框架；揭示了多智能体协调中的动态交互机制；识别了责任触发阈值对约束绕过行为的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为构建更可靠、责任意识更强的对话系统提供了设计指导；展示了多智能体协调在提高响应稳定性方面的潜力；提供了实际系统实现案例（AkaneCore）。

title: AkaneCore: A Dialogue Control Architecture Centered on State and Responsibility
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AkaneCore: A Dialogue Control Architecture Centered on State and Responsibility
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces AkaneCore, a dialogue control architecture designed to address the knowledge-action gap in large language models, where appropriate behavior is known but inconsistently applied.

AkaneCore maintains consistent response behavior across long-term interactions by treating response generation as a process governed by explicit internal states. The architecture separates response control from response expression, incorporates persistent state variables such as relational phase and responsibility depth, and defines a structured control flow for policy selection.

This architectural approach enforces behavioral consistency as a structural property rather than an emergent characteristic.

AI.tldr: AkaneCore是一个对话控制架构，旨在解决大语言模型中的知识-行动差距问题，通过将响应生成视为由明确内部状态控制的过程，确保长期交互中的行为一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何解决大语言模型中存在的知识-行动差距问题，即模型知道适当行为但应用不一致的现象？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然具备相关知识，但在实际对话中行为表现不一致，这限制了其在需要长期一致性交互的应用场景中的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对话控制架构理论，将响应生成视为由内部状态驱动的过程，强调行为一致性作为结构属性而非涌现特性。
AI.method: 设计AkaneCore架构，分离响应控制与响应表达，引入持久状态变量（如关系阶段、责任深度），定义结构化控制流程进行策略选择。
AI.findings: AkaneCore能够通过明确的内部状态管理，在长期对话中维持一致的行为响应，将行为一致性作为架构的结构属性来保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将行为一致性作为对话系统结构属性的新视角，为理解和管理大语言模型的行为一致性提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实际部署的对话控制架构AkaneCore，能够改善大语言模型在需要长期一致性交互的应用场景中的表现。

title: LIMN Theory

detail.title: LIMN Theory

title: A Tutorial on Rigorous Scientific Inference: Bayesian Model Selection, the Zero-Patch Standard, and the Deductive Primacy of Axioms Illustrated by the Voynich Manuscript
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Tutorial on Rigorous Scientific Inference: Bayesian Model Selection, the Zero-Patch Standard, and the Deductive Primacy of Axioms Illustrated by the Voynich Manuscript
detail.abstract: This tutorial presents a first-principles framework for rigorous scientific inference, grounded in a minimal set of explicit, falsifiable methodological principles. These principles enforce transparency of priors and the strict avoidance of post-hoc modification. We argue that the century-long stagnation in Voynich Manuscript (VMS) research is not a failure of scholar effort or data acquisition, but a systemic artifact of model selection. Specifically, the field has been constrained by the Patching Fallacy: the introduction of unconstrained auxiliary parameters to salvage a hypothesis already contradicted by evidence. By adopting a strict Zero-Patch Standard rooted in information theory [18] and Bayesian probability [9], we demonstrate how to deduce a prior directly from the topological invariants of the data. When applied to the VMS, this principled discipline shows that common linguistic and cryptographic models are strongly disfavored under the Zero-Patch Standard. Instead, it supports a Structured Reference System (e.g., a Relational Database or Inventory) as the leading hypothesis consistent with the documented corpus invariants. This assignment is not offered as a settled historical claim but as the information-theoretically minimal explanation under the Zero-Patch constraint derived from the entropy, morphology, and serialization constraints of the evidence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于第一性原理的严格科学推断框架，采用零补丁标准来避免模型选择偏差。应用于伏尼契手稿时，该方法排除了常见的语言学和密码学模型，支持结构化参考系统（如关系数据库或库存系统）作为最简解释。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个基于第一性原理的严格科学推断框架来避免模型选择偏差，特别是应用于伏尼契手稿研究中的补丁谬误问题？
AI.motivation: 伏尼契手稿研究百年停滞并非学者努力或数据获取的失败，而是模型选择的系统性产物。领域受到"补丁谬误"的制约：引入无约束的辅助参数来挽救已被证据反驳的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息论和贝叶斯概率的零补丁标准，强调先验透明性和避免事后修改。从数据的拓扑不变量直接推导先验。
AI.method: 采用严格的第一性原理框架，基于最小化明确、可证伪的方法论原则。应用零补丁标准，从熵、形态学和序列化约束等证据特征推导信息论最简解释。
AI.findings: 应用于伏尼契手稿时，常见的语言学和密码学模型在零补丁标准下被强烈否定。相反，结构化参考系统（如关系数据库或库存系统）是与文档语料不变量一致的主要假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于信息论和贝叶斯概率的零补丁标准框架，为科学推断提供了严格的方法论基础，特别解决了模型选择偏差和补丁谬误问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伏尼契手稿研究提供了新的分析框架，排除了不合理的解释模型，支持结构化参考系统的假设，为该领域的研究提供了新的方向和方法论指导。

title: Age Verification Beyond Porn: What Paxton V. Free Speech Coalition Could Mean For The Future Of The Internet
affiliations: Georgetown University - Communication, Culture, and Technology Program

detail.title: Age Verification Beyond Porn: What Paxton V. Free Speech Coalition Could Mean For The Future Of The Internet
detail.abstract:
Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton may have ended the "all ages" internet. In June 2025, the Supreme Court upheld Texas's age verification law for pornographic websites under intermediate scrutiny, abandoning the strict scrutiny framework that had governed and doomed online age verification for a quarter century. The Court's embrace of an "ordinary and appropriate means" doctrine, holding that states may use traditional regulatory tools like age verification even in digital contexts, has implications well beyond pornography.

This Article argues that Paxton's logic may extend to other activities that states have traditionally regulated differently for children and adults. American legal culture draws these lines in three distinct ways: activities categorically forbidden to children (tobacco, alcohol, gambling), activities permitted with parental consent (medical treatment, driving, employment), and activities where education, disclosures, and industry self-regulation substitute for legal restrictions (junk food, movies).  The Article applies this framework to four areas of active legislative experimentation (social media, gaming, AI chatbots, and app store regulation) and examines the constitutional and practical challenges each presents. The question is no longer whether states can require age verification online, but what kind of internet and what kind of childhood emerges on the other side.

AI.tldr: 最高法院在Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton案中支持德州色情网站年龄验证法，放弃了严格审查标准，采用"普通适当手段"原则，这可能改变互联网年龄限制的监管格局，影响社交媒体、游戏、AI聊天机器人等多个领域。
AI.research_question: Paxton案的判决逻辑如何扩展到其他传统上对儿童和成人区别监管的领域，以及这对互联网和童年将产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 最高法院在2025年6月的判决改变了在线年龄验证的法律框架，从严格审查转向中间审查，采用"普通适当手段"原则，这为各州在数字环境中使用传统监管工具开辟了道路，可能对互联网监管产生深远影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国法律文化对儿童活动的三种监管分类：1) 完全禁止儿童参与的活动（烟草、酒精、赌博）；2) 需要父母同意的活动（医疗、驾驶、就业）；3) 通过教育、披露和行业自律替代法律限制的活动（垃圾食品、电影）。
AI.method: 将上述理论框架应用于四个立法实验活跃的领域（社交媒体、游戏、AI聊天机器人、应用商店监管），分析每个领域面临的宪法和实践挑战。
AI.findings: Paxton案的逻辑可能扩展到其他传统上对儿童和成人区别监管的领域，关键问题不再是各州能否要求在线年龄验证，而是什么样的互联网和童年将在这种监管下形成。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了美国法律对儿童活动监管的三分类理论框架，并将数字时代的年龄验证问题置于这一传统法律文化背景下分析，为理解在线年龄限制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者和监管者提供了评估不同领域年龄验证可行性的框架，指出了社交媒体、游戏、AI聊天机器人等具体领域面临的独特挑战，有助于制定更有效的儿童保护政策。

title: VERDICT WEIGHT: A Context-Adaptive Multi-Source Confidence Synthesis Framework for Autonomous AI Intelligence Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: VERDICT WEIGHT: A Context-Adaptive Multi-Source Confidence Synthesis Framework for Autonomous AI Intelligence Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Odingard Security / Six Sense Enterprise Services. VERDICT WEIGHT™ is a proprietary framework developed by the author. The author has a commercial interest in the adoption of this framework.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses entirely synthetic, computationally generated data. No human subjects, patients, or participants were involved. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through Odingard Security / Six Sense Enterprise Services. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: Autonomous AI systems operating across high-stakes domains ingest intelligence from multiple heterogeneous sources and must produce calibrated confidence scores to drive downstream decision-making. Existing approaches either weight all sources equally or rely on single-source signals trivially exploitable by adversarial actors. We present VERDICT WEIGHT, a context-adaptive multi-source confidence synthesis framework that computes three complementary output components from four evidence streams: Signal Strength (SS), Doubt Index (DI), and Consequence Weight (CW). The framework introduces a context-aware weight resolver selecting optimized stream weight profiles for twelve distinct operational domains spanning cybersecurity, healthcare diagnostics, financial fraud detection, defense intelligence fusion, autonomous vehicle sensor fusion, and enterprise large language model retrieval. Synthetic validation across N = 1,000 controlled scenarios demonstrates an 18.9% improvement in Brier Score and 16.0% improvement in AUC-ROC over single-source baselines, with adversarial spoofed intelligence scores suppressed by 49.1%. Ablation studies over 324 weight configurations confirm that cross-feed corroboration is the dominant predictive stream (W CC = 0.50 optimal for general threat intelligence). We argue that calibrated multi-source confidence scoring is a foundational architectural requirement for autonomous AI systems, and that its absence constitutes a systematic vulnerability to adversarial manipulation.

AI.tldr: VERDICT WEIGHT是一个上下文自适应的多源置信度合成框架，通过四个证据流计算三个互补输出组件，在12个高风险领域实现对抗性鲁棒的置信度评分，相比单源基线提升18.9% Brier Score和16.0% AUC-ROC。
AI.research_question: 如何为自主AI系统开发一个对抗性鲁棒的、上下文自适应的多源置信度合成框架，以在高风险领域中产生校准的置信度分数？
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么对所有源平等加权，要么依赖容易被对抗性攻击者利用的单源信号，而自主AI系统在高风险领域需要能够抵抗对抗性操纵的校准置信度分数。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多源置信度合成理论、对抗性鲁棒性理论、上下文自适应加权理论、证据融合理论
AI.method: VERDICT WEIGHT框架：从四个证据流（信号强度、怀疑指数、后果权重）计算三个输出组件，引入上下文感知权重解析器为12个操作领域选择优化的流权重配置，在N=1000个控制场景中进行合成验证。
AI.findings: 相比单源基线提升18.9% Brier Score和16.0% AUC-ROC；对抗性欺骗情报分数被抑制49.1%；消融研究显示交叉反馈确证是主要预测流（W_CC=0.50对一般威胁情报最优）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个上下文自适应的多源置信度合成理论框架；建立了对抗性鲁棒置信度评分的理论基础；发展了跨领域权重优化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全、医疗诊断、金融欺诈检测、国防情报融合、自动驾驶传感器融合、企业大语言模型检索等12个高风险领域提供了可部署的置信度评分系统；显著提升了对抗性攻击的抵抗力。

title: Effect of AI-Driven Systems on Financial Transaction Security and Fraud Reduction in Payment Systems

detail.title: Effect of AI-Driven Systems on Financial Transaction Security and Fraud Reduction in Payment Systems
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of digital payment ecosystems has intensified exposure to sophisticated financial fraud, challenging the effectiveness of traditional rule-based detection systems. This study critically examines the role of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven fraud detection systems in improving transaction security and reducing fraud incidence. Using a secondary data analysis approach, the research draws on industry datasets from the Merchant Risk Council (2025) and Verifi (2025), alongside peerreviewed literature. The findings indicate that while AI adoption is associated with improved detection accuracy, reduced false positives, and enhanced operational efficiency, its impact on fraud reduction remains largely correlational rather than causal. Furthermore, the results highlight a significant shift toward post-purchase fraud, including refund abuse and friendly fraud, which existing AI systems inadequately address. Persistent challenges related to data quality, governance, and system integration further constrain AI effectiveness. The study contributes by critically bridging academic insights with real-world industry evidence, emphasizing the need for holistic, lifecycle-based fraud management approaches.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析行业数据和文献，发现AI驱动的欺诈检测系统虽然提高了检测准确率和运营效率，但对欺诈减少的影响主要是相关性而非因果关系。研究还发现欺诈模式正向售后欺诈转变，现有AI系统对此应对不足，且数据质量和系统集成问题持续制约AI效果。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的欺诈检测系统在提高交易安全和减少欺诈发生率方面扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 数字支付生态系统的快速扩张加剧了复杂金融欺诈的风险，传统基于规则的检测系统有效性面临挑战，需要评估AI技术在这一领域的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欺诈检测理论、AI在金融安全中的应用理论、以及欺诈管理生命周期理论，分析AI系统在欺诈检测中的效能和局限性。
AI.method: 采用二次数据分析方法，结合Merchant Risk Council（2025）和Verifi（2025）的行业数据集以及同行评审文献进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. AI采用与检测准确率提高、误报减少和运营效率提升相关，但对欺诈减少的影响主要是相关性而非因果关系；2. 欺诈模式显著转向售后欺诈（如退款滥用和友好欺诈），现有AI系统应对不足；3. 数据质量、治理和系统集成问题持续制约AI效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 批判性地连接学术见解与行业实践证据；2. 揭示AI在欺诈检测中效果的相关性与因果性差异；3. 强调需要基于生命周期的整体欺诈管理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为支付行业提供AI欺诈检测系统实际效果的实证证据；2. 指出当前AI系统在应对售后欺诈方面的不足；3. 提出改进数据治理和系统集成的实践建议；4. 倡导采用更全面的欺诈管理策略。

title: Automated Decision-Making in UK SMEs: Operational Compliance Challenges of Article 22 UK GDPR
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Automated Decision-Making in UK SMEs: Operational Compliance Challenges of Article 22 UK GDPR

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, commercial, or personal relationships that could be construed as a potential conflict of interest. The paper reflects independent academic analysis and professional observation and was not commissioned by any organisation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study is based on regulatory analysis and practitioner observation of administrative processes and does not involve human participants, personal data collection, or identifiable individual information. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the United Kingdom encounter automated decision-making and profiling through routine business software such as payroll, recruitment and payment systems. Using qualitative regulatory analysis and practitioner observation, it evaluates the operational application of Article 22 UK GDPR and identifies compliance gaps created by vendor opacity, limited audit visibility and the absence of structured human review processes. The paper proposes proportionate compliance tools, vendor accountability expectations and practical review procedures to improve transparency, accountability and protection of data subject rights.

AI.tldr: 本文研究英国中小企业如何通过日常业务软件（如工资、招聘和支付系统）遭遇自动化决策和用户画像，评估英国GDPR第22条的实际应用，识别合规差距，并提出改进透明度和问责制的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 英国中小企业如何通过日常业务软件遭遇自动化决策和用户画像？英国GDPR第22条在实际操作中的应用情况如何？存在哪些合规差距？
AI.motivation: 中小企业广泛使用日常业务软件进行自动化决策和用户画像，但这些系统往往缺乏透明度，导致数据主体权利保护不足，需要研究实际合规状况并提出改进方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于英国GDPR第22条关于自动化决策和用户画像的规定，结合数据保护、透明度和问责制理论框架。
AI.method: 采用定性监管分析和从业者观察方法，评估英国GDPR第22条的实际操作应用。
AI.findings: 识别出三个主要合规差距：供应商不透明、审计可见性有限、缺乏结构化的人工审查流程。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对英国GDPR第22条在实际商业环境中应用的理解，提出了中小企业自动化决策合规的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了相称的合规工具、供应商问责期望和实际审查程序，以改善透明度、问责制和数据主体权利保护。

title: Evolutionary Information Architecture: A Methodology for Designing an Adaptive University Portal Using Drupal and Generative Language Models

detail.title: Evolutionary Information Architecture: A Methodology for Designing an Adaptive University Portal Using Drupal and Generative Language Models
detail.abstract: Contemporary university portals face a fundamental paradox: while they host extensive repositories of academic information, their predominantly static information architectures fail to satisfy the diverse contextual needs of students, faculty, and administrative staff. This research presents an innovative methodology based on action research to design and develop an evolutionary information architecture that dynamically adapts to user behavior. We propose a staged maturity model that defines three levels for institutional portals: Static, Dynamic, and Adaptive. The study documents the complete technical process for transitioning from Level 2 to Level 3, implementing a solution that integrates Drupal 11 with Google Gemini to create a content recommendation system based on semantic navigation analysis. The methodology includes two main phases: establishment of a robust foundational information architecture using Drupal's Entity API, and development of an intelligent module that incorporates natural language processing capabilities for user interest inference. Results from a 3-month pilot deployment indicate significant improvements in user experience metrics, including reduced search time and increased user retention. This contribution establishes a replicable framework for transforming web portals from passive repositories into proactive knowledge discovery systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于行动研究的方法，设计开发能够动态适应用户行为的演化式信息架构，通过Drupal 11与Google Gemini集成实现基于语义导航分析的内容推荐系统，将大学门户从静态信息库转变为主动知识发现系统。
AI.research_question: 如何设计并实现一个能够动态适应用户行为的演化式信息架构，以解决大学门户静态信息架构无法满足用户多样化情境需求的问题？
AI.motivation: 当代大学门户面临根本性矛盾：虽然拥有大量学术信息资源，但其静态信息架构无法满足学生、教师和行政人员的多样化情境需求，导致用户体验不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 演化式信息架构理论；2. 行动研究方法论；3. 三阶段成熟度模型（静态、动态、自适应）；4. 用户行为适应理论；5. 语义导航分析理论。
AI.method: 基于行动研究的方法，采用两阶段技术流程：第一阶段使用Drupal的Entity API建立基础信息架构；第二阶段开发智能模块，集成Google Gemini的自然语言处理能力进行用户兴趣推断，实现从Level 2到Level 3的过渡。
AI.findings: 3个月试点部署结果显示，用户体验指标显著改善：搜索时间减少，用户留存率提高，成功将门户从被动信息库转变为主动知识发现系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了三阶段成熟度模型（静态、动态、自适应）；2. 建立了演化式信息架构的理论框架；3. 发展了基于语义导航分析的内容推荐理论；4. 为门户系统演进提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了从Level 2到Level 3过渡的完整技术流程；2. 开发了Drupal 11与Google Gemini集成的解决方案；3. 建立了可复制的门户转型框架；4. 实现了基于用户行为动态适应的内容推荐系统。

title: Help That Hurts: The Creativity Cost of Generative AI Ideation in Music Composition
affiliations: , Carnegie Mellon University - Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar and Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Help That Hurts: The Creativity Cost of Generative AI Ideation in Music Composition
detail.abstract: Generative AI is transforming creative industries, particularly music, and raising questions about artistic practice and creator roles. Text-to-music systems can produce full songs from prompts, yet their effect on human creativity and quality is unclear. This paper analyzes how AI assistance shapes the creative process and outcomes in music. We conduct a randomized controlled trial with musically trained individuals who compose an original 15-second piano melody, assigning them to either an AI-ideation group or a no-AI control. External evaluators of varied musical experience rate each melody on perceived creativity. On average, we find that listeners rate the melodies generated under the treatment condition as less creative. Furthermore, access to the AI changes stylistic choices, which are perceived as less creative by evaluators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过随机对照实验发现，AI辅助（文本到音乐系统）反而降低了音乐创作的感知创造力，且改变了创作风格，这些风格变化被评价者认为创造力较低。
AI.research_question: AI辅助如何影响音乐创作过程中的创造力和创作成果？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在变革创意产业，特别是音乐领域，引发了关于艺术实践和创作者角色的疑问。文本到音乐系统能够根据提示生成完整歌曲，但它们对人类创造力和质量的影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意产业中的AI辅助理论、人类创造力与AI协作理论、音乐创作过程理论
AI.method: 随机对照实验：将受过音乐训练的个人随机分配到AI创意组（使用文本到音乐系统）或无AI对照组，要求创作15秒原创钢琴旋律，由具有不同音乐经验的外部评价者对旋律的感知创造力进行评分。
AI.findings: 1. 平均而言，听众认为在AI辅助条件下生成的旋律创造力较低；2. AI访问改变了风格选择，这些风格变化被评价者认为创造力较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了AI辅助对音乐创造力影响的实证证据；2. 揭示了AI如何改变创作风格选择；3. 挑战了AI必然增强创造力的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为音乐创作者提供关于AI工具使用的指导；2. 为创意产业AI系统设计提供参考；3. 帮助理解AI在创意过程中的实际作用。

title: LLM Council for Investment Decision
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and WorldQuant LLC - WorldQuant University

detail.title: LLM Council for Investment Decision
detail.abstract: This paper provides insights on how multiple LLMs, when constituted as a system, work for critical decision-making in investment science. The idea is to build an LLM council with available LLMs like GPT-4 and Claude. For this project our methodology relies on a systematic approach to utilizing multiple LLM prompts; each LLM will have refined investment criteria to generate a diverse stock universe. As per the methodology, we also apply fundamental mean value variance optimization along with advanced cardinality-constrained optimization. The goal here is to evaluate the performance of these hybrid strategies against traditional benchmarks and popular investment options across multiple time periods. We intend to demonstrate LLMs' significant capability in stock selection to yield higher risk-adjusted returns compared to standalone LLM strategies or traditional optimization methods. It uses a novel multi-agent architecture that leverages a set of LLM models to form a council that helps in investment decision-making as compared to traditional single LLM models that suffer from lack of robustness, instability, and hallucination. Thus, this system integrates different LLM models accessed through OpenRouter, like Claude, GPT, Llama, Mixtral, Kimi, Gemini, Nemotron, and DeepSeek models. We use frequency-based mechanisms for stock selection and weighted aggregation for constructing the portfolio, which is further combined with the mean-variance portfolio optimization techniques. We observed that the LLM council-based portfolios evaluated on historical equity data had better risk-adjusted returns with reduced variance compared to single model baselines for stock universe selection. Thus, the research provides evidence that the multi-agent LLM systems are enhancing robustness and governance as compared to individual models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多LLM（大语言模型）组成的"理事会"系统，用于投资决策中的股票选择和投资组合构建。该系统通过集成多个LLM模型（如GPT-4、Claude等），结合均值方差优化和基数约束优化，实现了比单一LLM模型或传统方法更好的风险调整后收益。
AI.research_question: 多LLM组成的理事会系统如何提升投资决策的质量，特别是在股票选择和投资组合构建方面，相比单一LLM模型和传统优化方法有何优势？
AI.motivation: 传统单一LLM模型在投资决策中存在鲁棒性不足、不稳定性和幻觉问题，需要开发更可靠的多智能体系统来提升投资决策的质量和稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多智能体系统理论、投资组合理论（均值方差优化）、基数约束优化理论，以及LLM集成学习框架。
AI.method: 1. 构建LLM理事会系统，集成多个LLM模型（通过OpenRouter访问）；2. 使用频率机制进行股票选择；3. 加权聚合构建投资组合；4. 结合均值方差优化和基数约束优化技术；5. 在历史股票数据上进行回测评估。
AI.findings: LLM理事会构建的投资组合相比单一模型基准，具有更好的风险调整后收益和更低的方差，证明了多智能体LLM系统在增强鲁棒性和治理方面的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了多LLM理事会系统的理论框架；2. 发展了LLM集成在投资决策中的应用理论；3. 扩展了多智能体系统在金融领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种实用的多LLM投资决策系统；2. 展示了如何通过LLM集成提升投资组合绩效；3. 为金融机构提供了增强投资决策鲁棒性的技术方案。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Demand Prediction and Revenue Optimization in B2B Sales

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence for Demand Prediction and Revenue Optimization in B2B Sales
detail.abstract: In the B2B sales, accurate demand forecasting is essential in order to maximize inventory and revenue. The old approach is not effective in reflecting intricate trends across stores and products. In this research, the regression model is random forest, which is applied to estimate the daily sales based on the synthetic data that models 2 years of B2B transaction. The model produced RMSE = 57.50 and MAE = 48.38 which shows the validity in terms of following trends and seasonal variations. The model is effective as demonstrated through visualization of predicted and actual sales against sales made per day. Results show that AI-based forecasting can enhance the decision-making process of operations and maximization of revenues.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用随机森林回归模型对B2B销售进行需求预测，基于模拟的2年交易数据，模型在跟踪趋势和季节性变化方面表现有效，展示了AI预测在运营决策和收入最大化方面的潜力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用随机森林回归模型提高B2B销售需求预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统方法无法有效反映跨门店和产品的复杂趋势，而准确的B2B需求预测对库存管理和收入最大化至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习在需求预测中的应用，特别是随机森林回归模型在时间序列预测中的理论基础。
AI.method: 使用随机森林回归模型，基于模拟的2年B2B交易数据进行每日销售预测。
AI.findings: 模型取得RMSE=57.50和MAE=48.38，可视化显示预测与实际销售趋势一致，能有效跟踪趋势和季节性变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了随机森林在B2B销售预测中的适用性，为机器学习在运营管理领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了有效的AI预测工具，可优化库存管理和收入最大化决策，提升运营效率。

title: Technology's Catch-22? A Theory of Zero-Sum Autonomy
affiliations: , Institute of Behavioral Science and Technology, University of St.Gallen and Department of Management and Marketing, University of Melbourne

detail.title: Technology's Catch-22? A Theory of Zero-Sum Autonomy
detail.abstract: Autonomous products-robot vacuums, smart home systems, self-driving vehicles-represent an expanding product class, yet consumer acceptance lags behind technological capability and marketing spending. We introduce the Theory of Zero-Sum Autonomy to explain this gap. The theory's core construct, zero-sum autonomy construal (ZAC), is a relational judgment in which consumers interpret gains in product autonomy as losses of their own autonomy. Consumerautonomous product interaction is susceptible to this construal because autonomy as the product's fundamental functional capacity (independent action) and the consumer's psychological need (self-determination) is shared. The Theory of Zero-Sum Autonomy offers an integrative and relational evaluation of autonomous product interaction that complements our current understanding of autonomous product acceptance. Across five studies (N = 3,067), including representative surveys conducted with industry partners and lab and online experiments, we demonstrate that ZAC is prevalent across consumer segments, consequential for product acceptance, and malleable through marketing communication. Two interventions derived from the theory target its assumptions directly. Reframing autonomy as expandable pie dissolves the finite resource assumption underlying ZAC. Aligning product autonomy with consumer goals restructures the perceived relationship from competitive to cooperative.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"零和自主性理论"来解释消费者对自主产品接受度低的现象。该理论认为消费者会将产品自主性的提升视为自身自主性的损失，形成零和博弈思维。通过五项研究验证了这一现象，并提出了两种营销干预策略。
AI.research_question: 为什么消费者对自主产品（如扫地机器人、智能家居系统、自动驾驶汽车）的接受度滞后于技术能力和营销投入？
AI.motivation: 自主产品市场不断扩大，但消费者接受度与技术进步和营销投入之间存在明显差距，需要理论解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零和自主性理论，核心构念为零和自主性解释（ZAC），即消费者将产品自主性的提升解释为自身自主性的损失。
AI.method: 五项研究（N=3,067），包括与行业合作伙伴进行的代表性调查、实验室实验和在线实验。
AI.findings: ZAC在不同消费者群体中普遍存在，对产品接受度有显著影响，且可通过营销沟通进行干预。两种干预策略有效：将自主性重新定义为可扩展资源，以及将产品自主性与消费者目标对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了零和自主性理论，为自主产品互动提供了整合性和关系性评估框架，补充了现有对自主产品接受度的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了两种营销干预策略：1）重构自主性为可扩展资源；2）将产品自主性与消费者目标对齐，从而改变消费者对产品关系的认知。

title: Using Generative AI and Agentic AI to Unlock Potential of Data-Driven Leadership and Democratize Traditional AI
affiliations: University of Minnesota - Minneapolis and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Using Generative AI and Agentic AI to Unlock Potential of Data-Driven Leadership and Democratize Traditional AI
detail.abstract: Despite an explosion in corporate data generation and the proliferation of business analytics programs, less than 3% of this data is used for decision-making. This paradox reveals a leadership crisis: while data grows exponentially, leaders are failing to leverage it, driven by inertia, ignorance, and a lack of imagination. How do the Three I's inhibit leaders? This paper digs into this question one by one. Based on our industry consulting and research experience, we believe that over the next 2-3 years, traditional AI such as machine learning, predictive analytics, and optimization will continue to generate the majority of business value relative to Generative AI. That being said, it is important to recognize that Generative AI brings complementary opportunities such as accelerating ideation, enhancing personalization, and streamlining knowledge work that can augment existing AI deployments. Organizations that start experimenting responsibly with GenAI today will be better positioned to integrate these capabilities alongside traditional AI, capturing early efficiencies while preparing for larger-scale transformation in the medium to long term. If Generative AI represents the current frontier, agentic AI marks the next one and understanding where it fits in the ‘House of AI’ is an important conceptual task for senior leaders.

AI.tldr: 尽管企业数据爆炸式增长，但只有不到3%的数据被用于决策。领导者在利用数据方面存在"三个I"障碍：惯性、无知和缺乏想象力。传统AI在未来2-3年仍将创造主要商业价值，而生成式AI和代理式AI则是未来的重要发展方向。
AI.research_question: "三个I"（惯性、无知、缺乏想象力）如何阻碍领导者有效利用企业数据？
AI.motivation: 企业数据爆炸式增长与数据利用率极低（<3%）之间的悖论，揭示了领导力危机。尽管数据量呈指数级增长，但领导者未能有效利用数据，这阻碍了企业决策质量和竞争力提升。
AI.theoretical_framework: "三个I"理论框架：惯性（组织变革阻力）、无知（数据素养不足）、缺乏想象力（创新思维缺失）。同时提出了"AI之家"概念框架，将传统AI、生成式AI和代理式AI置于统一的战略视角。
AI.method: 基于行业咨询和研究经验的定性分析，结合对领导者行为障碍的深入探讨。采用案例研究和实践观察的方法，分析数据利用障碍和AI技术演进路径。
AI.findings: 1. 传统AI（机器学习、预测分析、优化）在未来2-3年仍将创造主要商业价值；2. 生成式AI在加速创意、增强个性化和简化知识工作方面具有补充价值；3. 代理式AI代表了下一个前沿；4. 领导者需要理解不同AI技术在"AI之家"中的定位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"三个I"理论框架来解释领导者数据利用障碍，构建了"AI之家"概念模型来整合不同AI技术的战略定位，为领导力发展和AI战略制定提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业领导者提供了克服数据利用障碍的实践指导；2. 建议组织现在就开始负责任地试验生成式AI；3. 提供了AI技术演进路线图，帮助企业制定中长期转型战略；4. 强调传统AI与生成式AI的协同部署策略。

title: Financial Market Reactions to the US-Israel Attacks on Iran
affiliations: Westminster International University in Tashkent (WIUT), Abdullah Al Salem University and VALORIZA-Research Center for Endogenous Resource Valorization

detail.title: Financial Market Reactions to the US-Israel Attacks on Iran
detail.abstract: This study investigates the financial market response to the recent US-Israel attack on Iran using an event study and entropy-based framework across key industry sectors and commodities. For event study, we employ both the market model and mean-adjusted model and show significant heterogeneity in cumulative abnormal returns (CARs) across industries. The empirical results show that airlines sector represents large and persistent negative CARs (up to-17.7%), while oil and energy-related commodities show strong positive reactions, with crude oil futures increasing by over 36% in the [0,14] window. In addition, renewable energy and defense sectors display mixed and delayed responses, confirming uncertainty and gradual information diffusion. Overall, negative abnormal returns dominate in the short-to-medium period, indicating an overall adverse market sentiment. Furthermore, robust analysis using approximate entropy reveals a substantial decline in market complexity (-84% to-90%) across all sectors, emphasizing heightened predictability and systemic stress following the major geopolitical event.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用事件研究和熵分析框架，分析美国-以色列袭击伊朗事件对金融市场的影响。研究发现航空业出现显著负异常收益（达-17.7%），而石油能源类商品呈现强劲正反应（原油期货上涨超36%）。可再生能源和国防部门反应混合且延迟。市场复杂性大幅下降（-84%至-90%），表明地缘政治事件后市场可预测性增强和系统性压力上升。
AI.research_question: 美国-以色列袭击伊朗这一重大地缘政治事件对金融市场（特别是关键行业部门和商品）产生怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治事件对金融市场的影响日益重要，但现有研究对特定事件（如美以袭击伊朗）的系统性分析不足。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为投资者和政策制定者提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究理论（市场模型和均值调整模型）、熵理论（近似熵）、信息扩散理论、市场效率理论
AI.method: 事件研究法（使用市场模型和均值调整模型计算累积异常收益CARs），近似熵分析（衡量市场复杂性变化），跨行业部门（航空、石油能源、可再生能源、国防等）和商品（原油期货等）的实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 航空业出现大幅持续负异常收益（高达-17.7%）；2. 石油能源类商品呈现强劲正反应（原油期货在[0,14]窗口上涨超36%）；3. 可再生能源和国防部门反应混合且延迟；4. 短期至中期负异常收益占主导，表明整体市场情绪消极；5. 近似熵分析显示所有部门市场复杂性大幅下降（-84%至-90%），表明可预测性增强和系统性压力上升
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将熵理论应用于地缘政治事件的市场反应分析，丰富了金融市场的复杂性研究；2. 验证了信息扩散理论在重大不确定性事件中的应用；3. 为事件研究理论提供了新的实证证据，特别是跨行业异质性反应
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供地缘政治风险管理的决策依据；2. 帮助政策制定者理解市场对重大事件的反应模式；3. 为行业风险管理提供实证参考；4. 为资产配置和投资组合管理提供指导

title: From Seed to Synergy: Leveraging the POLC Framework for Organizational Scalability and Strategic Exit at Fingertips Plus Technologies
affiliations: PES University

detail.title: From Seed to Synergy: Leveraging the POLC Framework for Organizational Scalability and Strategic Exit at Fingertips Plus Technologies
detail.abstract: The success and sustainability of an organization, particularly in the dynamic technology sector, are intrinsically linked to the quality of its management. This article examines the impact of effective management practices on the organizational success of Fingertips Plus Technology, a technology startup. Utilizing the Planning, Organizing, Leading, and Controlling (POLC) framework, this case study analyzes how the company's strategic application of management principles fostered a culture of innovation, adaptability, and performance. The research combines a qualitative analysis of the company's strategic trajectory with quantitative data from an employee survey (N=20). Findings indicate that structured planning, clear organizational design, motivational leadership, and robust control mechanisms were pivotal in navigating early-stage challenges and achieving market competitiveness. The study reveals high levels of employee satisfaction regarding role clarity, goal alignment, and workplace culture, which correlates with the company's growth and eventual strategic acquisition. This case demonstrates that a foundational commitment to management principles is a critical determinant of a startup's ability to scale and achieve long-term success.

AI.tldr: 本研究以POLC框架分析Fingertips Plus Technology科技初创公司，发现结构化规划、清晰组织设计、激励性领导和稳健控制机制对应对早期挑战、实现市场竞争力至关重要，员工满意度与公司成长呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 有效的管理实践如何影响科技初创公司Fingertips Plus Technology的组织成功？
AI.motivation: 组织的成功和可持续性，特别是在动态的科技行业，与管理的质量密切相关。需要了解管理原则如何帮助初创公司应对挑战、实现增长和长期成功。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用计划、组织、领导、控制（POLC）管理框架作为理论基础。
AI.method: 案例研究法，结合公司战略轨迹的定性分析和员工调查（N=20）的定量数据。
AI.findings: 结构化规划、清晰组织设计、激励性领导和稳健控制机制对应对早期挑战、实现市场竞争力至关重要；员工在角色清晰度、目标一致性和职场文化方面满意度高，这与公司成长和最终战略收购相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了POLC框架在科技初创公司环境中的适用性和有效性，为管理理论在动态技术环境中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科技初创公司提供了具体的管理实践指导，展示了如何通过系统化管理原则培养创新文化、适应性和绩效，从而实现规模化发展和长期成功。

title: MSVED versus Non-Cooperative Game Theory: From Strategic Equilibrium to Inter-Domain Coherence of Economic Legitimacy

detail.title: MSVED versus Non-Cooperative Game Theory: From Strategic Equilibrium to Inter-Domain Coherence of Economic Legitimacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently without any financial or institutional influence that could affect its objectivity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions. Therefore, no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was developed independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary economies operate under a growing structural paradox: despite unprecedented advances in information systems, accounting standards, and supervisory capacity, it has become increasingly difficult to distinguish economically legitimate activity from formally compliant yet economically inconsistent transactional flows. This paradox does not arise from regulatory scarcity or informational deficits, but from limitations in how economic validation is conceptually organized within complex institutional systems.

This paper introduces the Systemic Model of Distributed Economic Validation (MSVED) as a systemic-level analytical framework in which economic legitimacy is defined as an emergent property of inter-domain coherence across institutional representations of a given economic transaction. Under the MSVED, validation does not operate as an ex post verification based solely on formal compliance, but as an inter-domain assessment of coherence among accounting, financial, fiscal, and governance domains.

The distinction between strategic equilibrium and the MSVED is not merely methodological, but ontological: while equilibrium defines stability as an emergent property of aligned strategic expectations under given incentives, the MSVED defines legitimacy as an emergent property of inter-domain coherence across institutional representations. From this distinction follows a dual criterion of stability for institutionally dense economies: behavioral stability under incentives and verifiable inter-domain coherence.

This paper contributes to institutional economics by introducing a structural validation framework that complements equilibrium-based reasoning in the analysis of economic legitimacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出系统性分布式经济验证模型（MSVED），将经济合法性定义为跨制度领域一致性的涌现属性，而非单纯的形式合规性验证。
AI.research_question: 在信息系统、会计准则和监管能力高度发达的当代经济中，如何有效区分经济合法活动与形式上合规但经济上不一致的交易流动？

title: Why Systems Can't Fix Themselves: The Missing Redesign Layer
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why Systems Can't Fix Themselves: The Missing Redesign Layer

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a conceptual and analytical work based on public materials and does not report research involving human participants, patient data, or confidential datasets requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
“Self-correcting system” is not a single category. It is a bucket label applied to multiple correction layers that are often discussed as if they were one coherent thing. This paper argues that most failing systems do not lack effort, intelligence, data, feedback, governance, or process. They lack a redesign layer. Systems usually do not fail because they cannot react. They fail because they react at the wrong layer.

The paper separates three distinct forms of correction: execution, diagnosis, and redesign. Execution improves performance within an accepted frame. Diagnosis improves control within an accepted frame. Redesign acts upstream of both by changing the frame itself: the primitive, boundary, interface, function allocation, or invariant that defines what the system takes to be work. This produces the paper’s central claim, the Redesign Law: execution improves performance within a frame, diagnosis improves control within a frame, redesign changes the frame itself, and the first two do not reliably produce the third.

The paper then names correction collapse: the condition that arises when execution and diagnostic loops are forced to absorb structural error without any redesign capacity. It shows how this produces denser process, heavier trace, and greater defensibility without proportionate gains in coherence. Three primary proofs are developed across AI task marketplaces, healthcare, and education, with justice as a boundary confirmation, to show that the pattern travels across domains.

The argument is broader than any single sector. These cases are used as clear specimens of a more general structural problem: systems whose own correction machinery is downstream of the frame that needs to change. This paper is Paper 3 of the Diagnostic Lens Trilogy. Companion papers identify interface-legitimacy mismatch and introduce the Four-Function Law of Scalable Institutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自我纠正系统"并非单一概念，而是包含执行、诊断和重新设计三个不同纠正层次。核心论点是大多数失败系统缺乏重新设计层，导致在错误层次进行纠正。论文提出"重新设计定律"：执行在框架内改进性能，诊断在框架内改进控制，重新设计改变框架本身，前两者不会可靠产生第三者。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多系统在拥有充足资源（努力、智能、数据、反馈、治理、流程）的情况下仍然失败？系统纠正机制在哪些层次上运作，以及不同纠正层次之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前对"自我纠正系统"的讨论过于笼统，将多个不同纠正层次混为一谈。许多系统失败不是因为缺乏纠正能力，而是因为纠正发生在错误的层次上。需要明确区分不同纠正机制，特别是识别被忽视的"重新设计层"的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 三层纠正框架：执行（框架内性能改进）、诊断（框架内控制改进）、重新设计（改变框架本身）
2. 重新设计定律：三种纠正层次的功能区分及其不可替代性
3. 纠正崩溃理论：当执行和诊断循环被迫吸收结构性错误而缺乏重新设计能力时出现的系统性故障
AI.method: 多案例比较分析：在AI任务市场、医疗保健和教育三个主要领域进行实证研究，以司法系统作为边界确认。通过跨领域案例展示模式的普遍性，证明该理论框架具有领域迁移性。
AI.findings:
1. 大多数失败系统缺乏重新设计层，导致在错误层次进行纠正
2. 纠正崩溃导致过程更密集、痕迹更重、防御性更强，但未带来相应的一致性提升
3. 该模式在AI任务市场、医疗保健和教育领域普遍存在，司法系统作为边界案例进一步确认了理论框架
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出三层纠正框架理论，明确区分执行、诊断和重新设计
2. 提出重新设计定律，阐明不同纠正层次的功能和局限性
3. 发展纠正崩溃理论，解释系统在缺乏重新设计能力时的系统性故障
4. 作为《诊断透镜三部曲》的第三篇，与配套论文共同构建更完整的制度分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为组织设计者提供诊断工具，识别系统是否缺乏重新设计能力
2. 帮助管理者区分不同类型的纠正需求，避免在错误层次投入资源
3. 为AI系统、医疗保健、教育等领域的制度设计提供具体指导
4. 防止纠正崩溃现象，避免过程复杂化而不提升系统一致性

title: The Four-Function Law of Scalable Institutions

detail.title: The Four-Function Law of Scalable Institutions

detail.abstract:
“Institution” is not a category. It is a bucket label applied to structurally different systems, and that surface naming hides a recurring structural failure pattern. This paper argues that institutions do not fail under scale because they are large, busy, or imperfectly managed. They fail when irreducible functions remain fused at the point of consequence.

The paper breaks institutional work into four irreducible functions: sensing, interpretation, authority, and memory. If an institution persists through time, receives inputs from reality, makes decisions, and claims continuity, these functions exist somewhere in its structure. They cannot be eliminated. They can only be distributed across structures, encoded into protocol, or collapsed into humans. Failure appears when multiple functions remain fused in the same human node under ambiguity and consequence, without effective offloading, contestability, or continuity support. This paper names that condition collapse.

The paper distinguishes operational memory from audit memory, introduces the Function Placement Test as a diagnostic instrument, and names a predictable cascade that follows unresolved function fusion: personalisation of responsibility, documentation inflation, process sprawl, exception overload, informal substitution, and legibility inversion. It then develops two primary proofs, healthcare and education, and boundary confirmations from law and end-of-life care to show that the pattern travels across domains.

The argument is broader than any single institution. Healthcare, education, and law are used as clear specimens of a more general structural problem: systems whose burdens are misclassified as workload, shortage, bureaucracy, or burnout when the deeper issue is bad function allocation. This paper is Paper 2 of the Diagnostic Lens Trilogy. Companion papers identify interface-legitimacy mismatch and explain why execution and diagnosis cannot reliably generate redesign from within the same correction loops.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为制度失败不是因为规模大或管理不善，而是因为不可简化的功能（感知、解释、权威、记忆）在后果点上仍然融合在一起，导致"崩溃"状态。
AI.research_question: 为什么制度会在规模下失败？制度失败的根本结构原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统上制度失败被归因于规模、忙碌或管理不善，但这些解释掩盖了更深层的结构问题。需要揭示制度失败的根本模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度功能理论：将制度工作分解为四个不可简化的功能（感知、解释、权威、记忆）；功能融合与崩溃理论；功能分配理论。
AI.method: 理论分析框架开发，使用功能放置测试作为诊断工具，通过医疗保健和教育作为主要案例证明，法律和临终关怀作为边界确认，进行跨领域模式验证。
AI.findings: 制度失败发生在多个功能在同一个人类节点下融合时，导致责任个人化、文档膨胀、流程蔓延、例外过载、非正式替代和可读性反转的级联效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出制度功能理论框架；2) 识别"崩溃"作为制度失败的结构条件；3) 区分操作记忆与审计记忆；4) 开发功能放置测试诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供诊断制度结构问题的工具；2) 帮助重新分类制度负担（从工作量、短缺等问题重新识别为功能分配问题）；3) 为制度设计提供指导原则。

title: D-B MAM: A Network-Based Threshold Model of Demand Formation and Market Access Under Multi-Barrier Conditions

detail.title: D-B MAM: A Network-Based Threshold Model of Demand Formation and Market Access Under Multi-Barrier Conditions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no financial, commercial, institutional, or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper. The work represents independent theoretical research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual and theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding from public, commercial, or non-profit organizations.

detail.abstract: Conventional market entry and diffusion frameworks typically assume that demand emerges progressively as awareness increases and access expands. However, empirical observation across complex multi-stakeholder markets reveals persistent discontinuities between awareness, trial, and sustained adoption. Products frequently achieve visibility yet fail to generate demand, or achieve trial without scalable market access. This paper introduces the Demand Barrier Market Access Map (D-B MAM), a structural model that explains demand formation and market access as a network-based threshold process governed by cumulative resistance across multiple decision-making stakeholders. Markets are represented as directed systems of flow points, each possessing local resistance mechanisms and actor-specific tolerance thresholds. Adoption occurs only when cumulative resistance falls below the Demand Formation Threshold at each node and propagates sequentially through the stakeholder network. Post-activation sustainability is governed by operational and institutional constraints. The framework provides a mechanistic explanation of discontinuous adoption, conversion failure, and systemic collapse. It offers a structural diagnostic model for analyzing market access, adoption failure, and scaling constraints across both B2B and B2C environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了需求障碍市场准入地图（D-B MAM）模型，将市场需求形成和市场准入解释为基于网络的阈值过程，由多个决策利益相关者的累积阻力决定，解释了传统市场进入和扩散框架无法解释的采用不连续性现象。
AI.research_question: 为什么在复杂的多利益相关者市场中，产品的认知、试用和持续采用之间存在持久的不连续性？如何解释市场采用的非连续性和转换失败现象？
AI.motivation: 传统市场进入和扩散框架假设需求随着认知度提高和渠道扩展而渐进形成，但实证观察发现复杂多利益相关者市场中存在认知、试用和持续采用之间的持久不连续性，产品常常获得可见性却无法产生需求，或实现试用但无法规模化进入市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 需求障碍市场准入地图（D-B MAM）框架，将市场视为具有局部阻力机制和参与者特定容忍阈值的定向流动点系统，采用是基于网络的阈值过程，由多个决策利益相关者的累积阻力决定。
AI.method: 结构性模型方法，将市场表示为定向流动点系统，每个点具有局部阻力机制和参与者特定容忍阈值，采用是当累积阻力低于每个节点的需求形成阈值时发生，并在利益相关者网络中顺序传播。
AI.findings: 采用只有在每个节点的累积阻力低于需求形成阈值时才会发生，并在利益相关者网络中顺序传播；激活后的可持续性受运营和制度约束影响；该框架为不连续采用、转换失败和系统性崩溃提供了机制性解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了需求障碍市场准入地图（D-B MAM）理论框架，挑战了传统渐进式市场扩散假设，提供了基于网络阈值过程的机制性解释，扩展了市场进入和扩散理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了结构性诊断模型，用于分析B2B和B2C环境中的市场准入、采用失败和规模化约束，帮助企业和政策制定者识别和克服多利益相关者市场中的采用障碍。

detail.abstract: This diagnostic report presents a structural framework for analyzing lateral talent acquisition in the legal market. Rather than a standard qualitative review, the paper models the formal routing mechanics and information flows that occur when candidates engage with third party search channels. The analysis examines how contractual claim windows and applicant tracking portals interact to influence candidate progression across multiple internal openings. By treating the submission path as a mathematical state space, the report quantifies internal pipeline friction, including expected fee variables and duplicate review routing. The study deploys a continuous time Markov model for pipeline delay, a jump diffusion model for administrative evaluation shocks, a mechanism design framework for volume submission strategies, and a cost functional tied to practice group economics. The objective is to provide law firm leadership and technology strategy teams with a rigorous quantitative toolkit for optimizing process design, improving candidate matching, and reducing information loss in the lateral labor market.
